text:
# filter.ageMin

TL;DR:
- filter.ageMin sets the lowest allowed item-age score.

What it means:
- It filters on normalized item age buckets, not listing creation time.

Agent hint:
- Use it when item age matters and the workflow is bucket-based rather than exact-year based.
